description.value: China World Supermarket is a Chinese-language-oriented supermarket in Richmond, BC, serving the area's large East Asian community. The store operates from a standalone building on Odlin Crescent and stocks a broad range of Asian grocery products. For a touring cyclist, it offers a full supermarket resupply opportunity in suburban Richmond.
